detailed_description: The Image Resizer resizes one selected image in the browser with FileReader and an HTML canvas. After choosing an image file, the tool shows the original dimensions, fills width and height inputs with the source size, optionally keeps the aspect ratio locked while editing either dimension, and draws the resized result to a canvas. The resized preview can be downloaded as a PNG file. It does not provide output format selection, batch resizing, compression quality controls, GIF animation preservation, metadata handling, advanced resampling options, or image optimization guarantees.
usage_steps: Choose one image file from your device.
Review the original width and height shown beside the preview.
Enter the target width or height, leaving the aspect ratio lock enabled when needed.
Click Resize to draw the resized image preview.
Download the resized result as a PNG file, or clear the image and start over.
usage_examples: Resize a single screenshot to a smaller PNG for a quick prototype.
Change an uploaded image width while keeping the original aspect ratio.
Create a simple thumbnail preview from one selected image.
Test different pixel dimensions locally before downloading the resized PNG.
